title: Driver Terms: Making a Cleaning and Damage Fees Report and Submitting Evidence
content:
These clauses of the driver terms govern how a Cleaning and Damage Fees report is made and how evidence is put on it, at every fee level.

## Clauses

**1. Completed trips only.** A report can be made only on a completed trip. The test is the trip's own status on the system record, for the trip the report is raised on.

**2. Filing window.** A report must be made within the filing window: The filing window is counted in elapsed hours from the trip's drop-off moment, and the report must be registered no later than the level's filing window hours full hours after it. The window is 24 hours at the cleaning levels and 72 hours at the damage levels.

**3. Channels.** The driver reports through the driver app or driver support.

**4. Evidence submissions.** The driver may submit evidence up to the level's maximum number of evidence submissions per report, counted over the whole life of the report; evidence is accepted only while the assessment is reported, under review or denied.

**5. Entry into review.** The report enters review only when it has at least the level's minimum number of photos and, for levels that require a receipt, a document of a type the level accepts as the receipt; the photos must show the photo subjects the level requires.

**6. Evidence deadline.** When the minimum evidence is not on file the level's evidence deadline hours after the moment of the report, the report is denied (evidence deadline missed).

**7. Injury.** A report that mentions an injury to anyone is never handled as a fee and goes to Trust and Safety.

## The filing window in detail

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Clock starts | the trip's drop-off moment, as shown on the trip record |
| What is compared | the moment the report is registered |
| Unit | elapsed hours, not calendar days |
| Direction | the report must be registered no later than the end of the window |
| The end moment itself | inside the window |

Boundary pair (hypothetical, cleaning level, 24-hour window): a trip drops off at 18:30. A report registered exactly 24 elapsed hours later is registered at the end moment and is within the window; a report registered one minute after that is outside it. At a damage level the same trip's window ends 72 elapsed hours after the drop-off.

## Evidence acceptance by assessment status

| Assessment status | Evidence accepted |
|---|---|
| reported | Yes |
| under review | Yes |
| denied | Yes |
| charged, disputed, upheld or reversed | No |

## Points of judgement

- A report on a trip that was cancelled or never completed cannot be made, whatever the driver describes.
- A driver who has already used the level's maximum evidence submissions on a report has no further submission on it.
- Photos alone do not bring a Cleaning Fee Level 4 (Major) or damage-level report into review: those levels also require a document of an accepted type.
